description: This file contains test cases for GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport, validating the selection logic of network gateways in different scenarios within the OpenClaw project. It includes helper methods for creating mock GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway instances and multiple test functions that verify transport protocol switching based on gateway conditions.

classes.description: A struct containing test cases for GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport behaviors.
